FULL VALIDATED CONTRACT: Corrected amplified column-Hilbert estimate: there are universal C_col < infinity and e_col > 0 such that every H-CB datum with e <= e_col, every n >= 1, and every X in M_{n,1} tensor S_{P,Q} satisfy abs(<X,X>_n-||X||_{n,1}^2) <= C_col*e*||X||_{n,1}^2.
